reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN order_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS accessory_order_share
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
